item.text:
Continued. I isolated the remaining sub-case 1 recovery concern and turned it into a concrete liveness finding.

F21: `handlePrepareReply` sub-case 1 installs a recovered committed value but broadcasts no Commit.

`TestAuditPrepareReplySubcase1PropagatesCommit` supplies a local NONE reply, a `PREACCEPTED_EQ` reply, and then a `COMMITTED` reply:

```
sub-case 1 installed key=88; messages sent to 0 peers
sub-case 1 did not broadcast a Commit; PREACCEPTED/NONE replicas remain stuck
```

The recoverer has the committed value, but the preaccepted/none replicas receive nothing and can remain stuck until an unrelated recovery or timeout. This is a liveness/agreement-completion issue, distinct from F20 (Commit ballot) and F17 (conflict-table update). The report notes the caveat that a full schedule losing the original Commit and then producing a COMMITTED reply at the recoverer was not built.

Current status: 21 findings documented; four cluster controls pass; 34 epaxos finding tests fail as intended; both client failover tests fail; `go build ./...` passes; captured implementation files remain byte-identical to `../source`.
